name: recon-refresh-cfs-uat
description: Rebuilds the latest published CFS recon snapshots (settle, actual, traders) with the v4 builders so source_trade_id and the stored factors are filled. Same run, same settlement date, pointer untouched; a snapshot whose rows already have source_trade_id is skipped, so a second run does nothing. Takes the same advisory lock as the app refresh. No backup table: the rows are derived data and the builder deletes and rebuilds them by run id. Risky by the tool's definition (a DO block), so --apply asks for the typed phrase. Settle takes about 10 to 15 minutes for CFS; delete the actual and traders steps to skip them. Run with --session statement_timeout=0 --session synchronous_commit=off --session work_mem=256MB --session maintenance_work_mem=1GB. Then it runs the verify rule.

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND p.proname IN ('recon_materialize_settle','recon_materialize_actual','recon_materialize_traders') AND position('source_trade_id' IN p.prosrc) > 0
preconditions.reason: the three v4 builders are deployed

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name = 'helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table' AND column_name IN ('nc_factor','fx_nc_factor','invenio_product_code','product_name','exchange_name','source_trade_id')
preconditions.reason: the published settle view exposes the new columns
